claims.text: Google acquired the cloud-security firm Wiz in an all-cash deal worth approximately $32 billion [Source: ev-1].
The company announced this agreement on 2025-03-18, which marked the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1].
This transaction followed a previous event where Wiz rejected Google’s earlier offer of $23 billion in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
The strategic rationale for the acquisition was driven by Google Cloud, led by Thomas Kurian, aiming to close the security gap with competitors AWS and Azure [Source: ev-1].

By pursuing Wiz, Google bet that cloud-security consolidation would become the next battleground in the "cloud wars," while anticipating that AI-driven cloud adoption would serve as the primary demand driver [Source: ev-1].
The deal signaled these broader market dynamics regarding competition and technological trends. [Source: ev-1]
Following shareholder and regulatory steps, the transaction closed in 2025, with completion specifically reported in July 2025 [Source: ev-1].
